name: Moldova

most.note: Recommended for most people going to Moldova who haven't had it before. It spreads through food and water, and a good hotel doesn't remove the risk.
Check when you last had a tetanus, diphtheria and polio booster. If it was more than ten years ago and you'll be anywhere medical care is limited, a booster is recommended.

some.note: Worth considering for longer stays, for anyone who might need medical or dental treatment there, and for work with blood or needles.
Worth considering if you'll be around animals, in rural areas or far from medical care, and for children, who are bitten more often. The course takes three or four weeks, so book early.
Only for a few people: under-16s staying three months or more with local people, and healthcare workers.
Spread through food and water. Recommended for most trips to Moldova, and especially if you're staying with family or eating away from the tourist trail.

certificates: No yellow fever certificate is needed.
